outcome: cesarean section due to failed induction
cohort: 200 pregnant women receiving prenatal care at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology Government Medical College, Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh, India
finding: This study investigated the relationship between cervical length measured by transvaginal ultrasound between 19 and 24 weeks' gestation and labor outcomes.
mod_finding: The study examined mode of delivery (including cesarean section after failed induction) as one of the labor outcomes related to cervical length.
